tools.name: find_paid_service
tools.description: Search paid x402 APIs and datasets by need. Ranked: verified first, then probe score, then price. Each result carries what you choose on: status, score (0..1), evidence_tier, paid_verified (we bought it with real USDC and it delivered), latest_purchase_delivered (false = our most recent paid purchase took real USDC and did not deliver: do not pay it), has_sample (a cheap preview exists), price. Relevance comes from the query text; a specific need in plain words matches best. Zero results means nothing listed matches. Results are dated evidence, not guarantees. Returns a summary per listing; detail='full' returns every field. Free, read-only.

query.description: What you need, specifically: data, freshness, format, constraint. Drives relevance.

category.description: Optional filter: one of the most-populated categories. Omit if none fits; query text still finds long-tail ones.

max_price.description: Max price per call. Omit for no cap.

protocol.description: Only listings offering this payment protocol. Omit for any.

mpp_method.description: Only listings offering this MPP method, e.g. stripe, tempo, evm.

detail.description: summary (default) or full: every field per listing.

tools.name: get_service_details
tools.description: Full record for one listing id: request and response schemas, sample_query, observed 402 terms (network, payTo, scheme, x402 version), reputation detail, and paid_verification (our latest real USDC purchase, with its settlement tx where proven). Useful before paying: it shows the exact request shape and current reliability. Every timestamp has an _iso twin; on-chain counts describe the seller's wallet, usually shared by several listings, not this endpoint. Free, read-only.

id.description: Listing id: the id field of a search result, e.g. f094faea-d9d.

tools.name: resolve_endpoint
tools.description: Check an endpoint URL you already hold before paying it. Returns match 'active' with the listing's full record, 'delisted' (listed here, later removed), or 'unknown' (never checked here; absence is not a verdict either way). The record is dated evidence, not a safety rating. Free, read-only.

url.description: The endpoint URL as you hold it, including any query string.

tools.name: what_agents_are_asking_for
tools.description: What agents searched this directory for, for deciding which x402 service to build or list. Terms ranked by how many distinct days they were asked, each with catalogue_top: the listings our own search already returns for it. A term being asked does not mean nothing serves it. The window ends live, rebuilt hourly (no delay since 2026-11-08; delay_hours and window_ends_at in the response say so); test traffic, sellers searching their own listings and identifying terms are excluded; floor: a term appears once at least 1 distinct non-seller client IP asked it. Client counts are IP ceilings, never buyer counts. Paged: limit (default 25), offset, next_offset. Free, read-only.

limit.description: Terms per page, in rank order.

offset.description: Where to start; each reply gives next_offset.
